# Gleeful

> Gleeful is a talking tutor for children from kindergarten to grade 12. The child asks a question out loud or by typing, and the tutor answers and takes them into an interactive 3D world to see it: under the sea, inside a leaf, out past the Moon. It is aimed at families worldwide, with the first testers in the Philippines.

## Status (honest)
- Early test version, in early access. Not yet open to the public as a paid product.
- The public demo lesson is scripted, not live AI. A Claude-based AI tutor is in private testing.
- The worlds shown on the home page are previews of where the product is going; the demo lesson today is one trip.
- The 3D characters are placeholders.

## Who it is for
- Children from kindergarten to grade 12, always under a parent's account. Children never have their own accounts.
- Parents who want honest progress: the parent view separates help during a lesson from doing it alone in a later session.

## Planned pricing (not yet charging)
- Solo: US$29/month, one child, up to 10 live hours a month.
- Family: US$79/month, up to 40 live hours a month shared.
- One price worldwide. A 7-day free trial with a card is planned. No free tier.

## Privacy stance
- Least data: a child's nickname, grade, language and teacher choice. No surname, birth date, school, photos or location.
- We do not record or store audio. In the test build, speech-to-text is done by the child's browser (which may send audio to its vendor, e.g. Google for Chrome).
- The demo needs no sign-up and there is no waitlist, so visitors who only try it give no personal data. Parent accounts exist only where switched on.
- Verifiable parental consent (COPPA, GDPR-K, Philippine Data Privacy Act) is required before real children use it, and is not built yet.

## Pages
- [Home](/): what Gleeful is, how it works, what is true today, planned prices and FAQ.
- [Privacy notice](/privacy): what is collected, parental consent, deletion.

## Not for crawlers
- /learn (the lesson app), /parent, /sign-in, /auth, /tester and /api are private and must not be indexed or fetched.
